title: 第1章 下坠第2章 无量仙门无念
lines: 我叫白枫。
这个世界只剩下我一个人了。
看着这条偏街上的二层建筑，又低头看了看手里捧着的青花瓷骨灰坛子，我苦笑着摇了摇头。
这个拉扯我长大的老头走了。
我甚至到现在不知道这老头到底是不是我的亲爷爷。
虽然他从来没有怎么管过我，动不动也是非打即骂，但是我还是很感谢这老头把我养育成年。
老头酷爱喝酒，整天都是醉醺醺的，而这次却是喝醉了一头扎进路旁的水渠给淹死了。
可悲的是那水渠的水只有半米深。
没有任何赔偿，老头也没有留下任何钱财，只有在被火化的时候内裤上的兜里发现了一把黑乎乎的钥匙。
火葬场的工作人员郑重其事的交给了我，想来能放在那么隐蔽位置的钥匙一定很珍贵吧。
只有我相当无语。
老头但凡有一点钱早就换酒喝了，这些年自己能长这么大也算是个奇迹。
哪能有什么财产呢。
手里捧着那还带着莫名味道的钥匙，心里一阵无语，但是这也算是他唯一的遗物了。
思绪飘来，再次抬头看了看这偏街的二层建筑，这二层建筑古香古色，韵味十足，虽然古旧但是却不显得破。
但是在这穷乡僻壤的镇子上，这房子却不值什么钱。
没错，这老头虽然什么钱财也没有留下，但是留给我这条偏街上的一栋房子，我也不至于露宿街头，而这里也是我长大的地方。
手中的青花瓷骨灰坛是我花了三十块钱在街头杂货铺上买的腌咸菜用的坛子，那青花瓷一看就是用颜料笔描上去的。
轻轻的推开古朴的大门，映入眼帘的除下一墙壁的橱窗台，剩下的空无一物。
甚至连把椅子都没有，无奈的叹了口气，要不是墙壁上的展示台拆不下来，应该也早就被这老登拿去换酒喝了。
把骨灰坛放在了中间的一个橱窗上，我还是恭恭敬敬的举了个躬。
不管怎么说，这老头把我养育成人，也给我了一个遮风挡雨的家。
说心里不难受都是假的，红着眼睛看着那小小的骨灰坛，我深深的吸了口气。
“老头，先委屈你了，我全身上下就剩那三十块钱了，只能对付给你买酸菜坛子了，但好歹也是个青花瓷的，墓地你就先别想了，等我哪天发财了再跟你考虑一下吧。”
深深的吸了一口气，平复了下心情。
我不由得摸了摸肚子。
外面得天色已经慢慢变暗，而我现在却身无分文，就连家里得米缸都见底了。
把大门关上，我来到了后院，这栋小楼后面有个小院，小院没有什么装饰，除了正中间有条青石小路通向后面得一间房子外，还有一旁得一口水井，其他地方都是些杂草和泥土。
老头抠门得很，其他人早就通上了自来水，老头愣是不愿意花一分钱，所以他们一直吃得都是这院中的井水。
熟练得拿桶从井里打出一桶水，拿起一旁得葫芦瓢就喝上一瓢。
喝完以后，肚子里饥饿仿佛减轻了一些。
后院里还有一间房子，这是老头住得地方，自己平常住在前面得二楼，后面除了老头住得地方还有厨房和杂物间。
不自觉下摸了下口袋里留下的那把钥匙。
钥匙很普通，颜色乌黑发亮，不知道是不是经常不见天日的原因。
慢慢得打开了老头得房间，扑面而来得就是一阵发霉得味道。
老头虽然住在这里，但是却不经常回来，更多的还是喝醉以后不知道睡哪里了，房间光线很暗，一张普通木床上乱糟糟得放着一床被子，被子领口也是被磨得乌黑发亮。
content_en:
My name is Bai Feng.
I am the only one left in this world.
Looking at the two-story building on this side street, and then looking down at the blue and white porcelain ashes jar in my hand, I smiled bitterly and shook my head.
The old man who helped me grow up is gone.
I still don’t even know if this old man is my biological grandfather.
Although he never took care of me and would always beat or scold me, I am still very grateful to this old man for raising me up.
The old man loved drinking and was drunk all day long, but this time he jumped into the ditch by the road and drowned.
Sadly, the water in the canal is only half a meter deep.
There was no compensation, and the old man did not leave any money. Only a black key was found in the pocket of his underwear when he was cremated.
The staff at the crematorium handed it over to me solemnly, thinking that the key must be very precious to be placed in such a hidden location.
I am the only one who is quite speechless.
As long as the old man had a little money, he would have exchanged it for alcohol. It was a miracle that he had grown so big over the years.
How can I have any property?
Holding the key with an inexplicable smell in his hand, he felt speechless, but this was his only relic.
As my thoughts drifted away, I looked up again at the two-story building on the side street. This two-story building was antique and full of charm. Although it was old, it didn't look shabby.
But in this remote town, the house was not worth much.
That's right, although the old man didn't leave any money behind, he left me a house on this side street so that I wouldn't have to sleep on the street, and this is where I grew up.
The blue and white porcelain urn in my hand is a pickle jar I bought at a street grocery store for thirty yuan. The blue and white porcelain was painted on with a paint pen.
Gently pushing open the quaint door, what came into view was nothing but the window display along the wall.
There wasn't even a chair. He sighed helplessly. If the display table on the wall hadn't been removed, he would have exchanged it for drinks.
After placing the urn on a display window in the middle, I bowed respectfully.
Anyway, this old man raised me up and gave me a sheltered home.
It would be a lie to say that I didn't feel uncomfortable. Looking at the small urn with red eyes, I took a deep breath.
"Old man, I have wronged you first. I only have thirty yuan left in my body, so I can only buy you a pickled vegetable jar, but after all, it is a blue and white porcelain. Don't think about the cemetery for now. I will consider it with you when I get rich one day."
He took a deep breath and calmed down.
I couldn't help but touch my belly.
The sky outside has gradually darkened, but now I am penniless, and even the rice vat at home has bottomed out.
After closing the door, I went to the backyard. There was a small courtyard behind the small building. There was no decoration in the small courtyard. Except for a bluestone path in the middle leading to a house in the back, and a well on the side, the rest was full of weeds and dirt.
The old man was very stingy, and the others had already had running water. The old man was unwilling to spend a penny, so they always drank water from the well in the courtyard.
He was so skilled that he took a bucket to draw a bucket of water from the well, and he picked up the gourd and gourd beside him and drank a sip.
After drinking it, the hunger in my stomach seemed to be alleviated.
There is also a house in the backyard, which is where the old man lives. I usually live on the second floor in the front. In addition to the old man's house, there is a kitchen and a utility room in the back.
Unconsciously, he touched the key left in his pocket.
The key is very ordinary, black and shiny in color. I don’t know if it’s because it often disappears from the light of day.
Slowly opening the old man's room, a musty smell hit his face.
Although the old man lived here, he didn't come back often. Most of the time, he didn't know where to sleep after getting drunk. The room was very dark, and there was a quilt on an ordinary wooden bed in a mess, and the collar of the quilt was worn black and shiny.
